text:
alice.p: Planning sync — Datadog + OpenTelemetry observability bundle for GPU marketplace demo day. Need alignment on dashboards, embargo, SI enablement, and live demos. Proposed agenda: 1) dashboard artifacts 2) PR/embargo 3) partner quotes/logos 4) demo ops. Wed 10am PT? 

ben.o: I can own the sample GPU trace + latency dashboard. Will prototype panels for KV cache hit rate, per-token latency percentiles, and trace spans. Drafting now. 

ben.o: Pushing a sample Datadog dashboard snippet (rough):
```json
{
  "title": "Redwood GPU Inference Observability",
  "widgets": [
    {"type":"timeseries","query":"avg:inference.latency{model:rw-v1} by {host}"},
    {"type":"query_value","query":"avg:kv.cache_hit_rate{env:prod}"}
  ]
}
```

evie.devrel: I can do the demo recording + quickstart. Need a runbook and sample curl + SDK examples. Can we lock the sample dataset? 

carlos.g: GTM note — target public launch window: 2026-04-05 to coincide with marketplace listing. We need partner quote + logo usage approval by 2026-03-25. @dana.legal, can Legal expedite? 

dana.legal: @carlos.g we need signed partner PR consent and approved quote text by 2026-03-24 EOD. Also confirm that Datadog is ok with using their logo in the demo tile. I can draft the MSA addendum if needed. 

alice.p: Ben, please add a link to the working dashboard in the doc. Evie, I'll add the runbook skeleton under /docs/marketplace/obs-bundle. 

ben.o: Link: https://redwood-internal.slack.link/dashboard-draft (working). Also added a small stderr snippet for trace sampling config:
```
# otelcol config snippet
processors:
  batch:
  tail_sampling:
    decision_wait: 5s
    policies: []
```

evie.devrel: I'll schedule a dry-run demo on 2026-03-28 10am PT. Can ops provision a GPU node for 2 hours? @ops-bot any chance? 

ops-bot: Scheduled: gpu-demo-node-07 reserved 2026-03-28T10:00Z for 2h. :white_check_mark: 

carlos.g: I'll chase Datadog for a short quote. If we don't get it by 3/22, we may have to use a generic partner line. 

dana.legal: Also flagging embargo: partners often require 48h pre-announce review. Recommend internal cut: 2026-04-03. 

alice.p: Good call. Action items:
- ben.o: finalize dashboard JSON + example queries (due 2026-03-22)
- evie.devrel: draft blog + demo recording (due 2026-03-22)
- carlos.g: partner quote + logo sign-off (due 2026-03-22)
- dana.legal: PR consent template (due 2026-03-20)
- ops-bot: confirm staging resources (done)

ben.o: ack :thumbsup: 

evie.devrel: ack

carlos.g: ack — will ping account team @datadog-eng

alice.p: Thanks team. I'll send calendar invite for Wed 10am PT and attach this thread. If you want items added, reply here. :rocket:
